svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Interconnection of Smoke Alarms

g.text: More than one alarm required: the
actuation of any one causes all alarms
within the dwelling unit to sound
House with a secondary suite, Sentences (2) and (3)
alarm in each dwelling unit and common
not less than 45 min, or the building

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Where more than one smoke alarm is required in a
dwelling unit, the smoke alarms are
interconnected so that the actuation of any one
alarm causes all alarms within the dwelling unit
to sound
In a house with a secondary suite including their
common spaces, the smoke alarms are
interconnected as in Clause (a) or (b)
(a) All photo-electric and interconnected so any one
causes all within the house, including common
spaces, to sound, when the fire separations of
rated not less than 15 min (see Sentence
9.10.3.1.(2)), or (b) an additional photo-electric
alarm in each dwelling unit and common space,
interconnected so one causes the additional alarms
in the others to sound, when those separations are
rated not less than 30 min (see Sentence
9.10.3.1.(3)). Except as in Sentence (3).
Additional smoke alarms and interconnection
between dwelling units and common spaces are not
required
If the fire separations of Articles 9.10.9.16. and
9.10.9.17. are rated not less than 45 min, or the
building is sprinklered.
Drawn: plans with walls cut low. Red dashed: interconnection. Red walls in B: fire separations.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.19.5. (page 9-99)
